correctness.rationale: For odd special \(d>1\), write \(d=A^2+B^2\) with \(\gcd(A,B)=1\) and opposite parity, choose \(Au+Bv=1\), and set \(c=(m-u^2-v^2)/2\), \(a=Ac+u\), \(b=Bc+v\) after a parity-preserving Bezout shift. The identity is exact, and a common divisor of \(a,b,c\) divides \(u,v\) and therefore \(1\). For even special \(d=C^2+D^2\) with odd coprime \(C,D\), the same construction with right side \(1\) handles odd \(m\); right side \(2\) with odd \(u,v\) handles \(m\equiv2\pmod4\); and right side \(2\) with even \(u,v\) gives odd \(c\) and handles \(m\equiv0\pmod8\). In each case any common divisor is forced to divide \(1\) or \(2\), with parity excluding \(2\). For \(m\equiv4\pmod8\), odd \(c\) would require a sum of two squares congruent to \(6\pmod8\), while even \(c\) forces \(a,b,c\) all even. The special case \(d=1\) has the direct primitive identity in `RESULT.md`. Parametric shifts make \(|c|\) unbounded, so finitely many zero-coordinate exceptions can be discarded.

originality.rationale: The closest papers classify ordinary nonzero universality, not primitive universality. Lam's 2015 construction and Dung--Thang's 2021 construction provide the identities, but neither theorem requires \(\gcd(a,b,c)=1\) or states the exact primitive value set. The new comparison is sharp: for even special \(d\), the published ordinary universality includes the residue \(4\pmod8\), whereas every representation there is necessarily imprimitive. Targeted semantic-index and web searches for the primitive refinement, exact form, and residue obstruction found no implication-equivalent statement.

value.rationale: The primitive restriction is a natural strengthening of the source problem rather than an arbitrary slice: primitive representations are the standard way to remove common scaling in quadratic-form arithmetic. The result gives a complete dichotomy across the entire classified special family. Odd special forms retain universality even under primitivity, while every even special form loses exactly one modulo-\(8\) class. This identifies the precise local obstruction hidden by the existing ordinary-universality constructions and supplies infinitely many primitive witnesses in every allowed class.
